reading.subtitle: Private source. Qualified recall. A public description of the boundary.
reading.why: An agent's summary is not a substitute for the original wording behind a project decision. SISO Source preserves conversation records and supports bounded recall while keeping source identity, authorship uncertainty and missing coverage visible. Full conversations remain private because they can include personal or client context; only reviewed metadata belongs in this Library.

highlights.title: Evidence is not automatic authority
highlights.summary: Events and decisions carry public operational evidence; captured wording alone does not authorize an action or establish authorship.
